description: Pixel statistics per channel and image: count, min, max, mean, std, percentiles p1–p99, zero and saturated fractions (at the detector's 2^bits−1 when recorded), histogram; RGB images also per component. per=plane adds every plane; per=well or field gives rows per well of a screening plate. mip='z' measures the maximum-intensity projection; whole slides: a coarser level and/or a region. Measurements on one plane: line (intensity profile, FWHM), polygon (statistics inside), objects (count nuclei, cells or spots; preview marks=objects shows them), lanes (gel and blot lanes, band volumes and sizes; preview marks=lanes).

LadderRequest.description: The marker lane and its sizes.

lane.description: Lane number of the marker (1 = leftmost).

sizes.description: Marker sizes from the top of the lane down (largest first), e.g. kDa or bp.

unit.description: Unit of the sizes, e.g. `kDa` or `bp`.

LanesRequest.description: How lanes and bands are found. Everything is optional.

count.description: Number of lanes. Default: found from the image.

ladder.description: The marker lane and its sizes; bands then get sizes.

min_share.description: Bands lower than this share of the lane's highest band are dropped. Default 0.05.

polarity.description: Bright bands (fluorescence, chemiluminescence) or dark ones (stains). Default auto. `auto` = from the image: dark objects on a bright background (brightfield) or bright ones; `bright` = objects brighter than the background (fluorescence); `dark` = objects darker than the background (brightfield).

profiles.description: Return each lane's profile (200 values from the top down). Default false.

width_px.description: Lane width in pixels. Default 0.7 lane pitches.

ObjectsRequest.description: How objects are found. Everything is optional; the defaults suit nuclei.

diameter_px.description: The same in pixels, for images without a pixel size.

diameter_um.description: Expected object diameter in µm. Default: measured from the image (spots: 0.5 µm).

kind.description: Default nuclei. `nuclei` = nuclei (default): touching nuclei are split; `cells` = whole cells stained throughout (larger; touching cells are split); `spots` = small bright spots (puncta, foci, single molecules), found by a Laplacian of Gaussian.

max_area_um2.description: Largest object kept in µm². Default: no limit.

max_objects.description: Objects listed (in reading order). Default 100; the counts cover all.

method.description: Default auto. `auto` = Otsu's, or the triangle method when objects are sparse; `otsu` = Otsu's (two classes of similar spread); `triangle` = the triangle method (a big background peak, few objects); `local` = each pixel against its neighbourhood (uneven staining).

min_area_um2.description: Smallest object kept in µm². Default: a fifth of the expected area.

polarity.description: Default auto. `auto` = from the image: dark objects on a bright background (brightfield) or bright ones; `bright` = objects brighter than the background (fluorescence); `dark` = objects darker than the background (brightfield).

split.description: Cut touching objects apart (seeded watershed). Default true.

stain.description: RGB images. Default auto. `auto` = hematoxylin for brightfield (stained tissue); for fluorescence, blue for nuclei when the blue component holds signal, else the brightest component; `hematoxylin` = the nuclear stain of H&E and IHC, by colour deconvolution; `eosin` = eosin, by colour deconvolution; `dab` = the brown IHC chromogen, by colour deconvolution; `red` = one component; `green` = one component; `blue` = one component; `luminance` = the mean of the components.

threshold.description: Threshold in raw units of what is measured (spots: the height above the local background). Default: chosen by `method`.

Region.description: A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

x.description: Left edge (column of the first pixel).

y.description: Top edge (row of the first pixel).

bins.description: Histogram bins (0 = none). Default 32, at most 65536.

file.description: Absolute or working-directory-relative path to the instrument file, or a plate's index file or folder (Harmony `Index.idx.xml`, ImageXpress `.HTD`, CellVoyager `MeasurementData.mlf`, OME-Zarr plate).

lanes.description: Lanes and bands of a gel or blot in `region` or the whole plane: each lane's total and each band's row and background-subtracted volume (with `ladder`, its size). `{}` finds the lanes; preview marks=lanes draws them.

line.description: Intensity profile along the line `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` (pixels of `level`, as on the preview rulers): values per channel, peak position and FWHM in px and µm.

line_width.description: Profile width in pixels, averaged across the line. Default 1.

mip.description: Maximum-intensity projection first: `z` (per image, channel and time point: the largest value of each pixel over the selected z planes) or `t`; the statistics are of the projections. `z` = Along z: one projected plane per image, channel and time point; `t` = Along t: one projected plane per image, channel and z.

objects.description: Count objects in `region`, `polygon` or the whole plane: count, density, sizes, centroids, each object's mean in every channel and how many are positive per channel. `{}` counts nuclei with settings taken from the image (size, threshold, H&E colour deconvolution). Found in a DNA-stain channel unless `select` names one.

per.description: Rows. `channel` = channel and image aggregates (default); `plane` = also one entry per plane (image, c, z, t); `well` = a screening plate (pass the plate folder or index, never one TIFF): one row per well × channel over the well's fields; `field` = a screening plate: one row per well × field × channel.

polygon.description: Statistics inside this polygon `[[x, y], ...]` (pixels of `level`): area, mean, std, median, sum per channel.

region.description: Only this rectangle of each plane, `{x, y, width, height}` in the pixel coordinates of `level` (e.g. the 512 x 512 centre of a whole-slide image).

scale.description: Histogram spacing: `linear` (default) or `log`. `linear` = Equal-width bins from `min` to `max` (integer data: to `max + 1`, so each bin holds whole values); `log` = Geometrically spaced bins from the smallest positive value to `max`; values ≤ 0 are counted in `nonpositive`. Suited to data spanning decades (photon counts, spectra).

select.description: Plane selection strings such as `c=0`, `z=2-5`, `t=0,3`. The aggregates cover exactly the selection.

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

name: openreadout_stats

fraction_of_lane.description: Share of the lane's band volume.

height.description: Height of the maximum above the background, in stored units.

number.description: Band number in its lane, from the top.

relative.description: Volume relative to the strongest band of the image (1 = the strongest band).

saturated_px.description: Pixels of the band at the saturation level: its volume is a lower bound.

size.description: Size from the ladder, in its unit.

y.description: Row of the band's maximum (full-resolution pixels).

y_range.description: First and last row of the band.

ChannelStats.description: Statistics of every selected plane of one channel.

components.description:
Multi-sample (RGB) pixels: the statistics of each colour component on its own
(`components[0]` = red, `[1]` = green, `[2]` = blue).

image_name.description: Name of the image (scene, series, position) the channel belongs to, if recorded.

stats.description: Statistics over those planes (RGB: every colour sample pooled).

ComponentStats.description: Statistics of one colour component of interleaved multi-sample (RGB) pixels.

sample.description:
Sample index within a pixel: for RGB 0 = red, 1 = green, 2 = blue (every reader returns
R, G, B order; CZI's stored B, G, R is swapped on read).

stats.description: Statistics of that component's samples only.

CountConfidence.description: How far a count can be trusted.

oneOf.description: the objects look like what was asked for
many objects are irregular or of the wrong size: check a picture before quoting the count

Histogram.description: A histogram of the finite samples.

edges.description:
`bins + 1` bin edges; bin `i` is `[edges[i], edges[i+1])`, the last bin includes its
upper edge.

nonpositive.description: Log scale only: samples ≤ 0, which have no place on a log axis.

oneOf.description:
Equal-width bins from `min` to `max` (integer data: to `max + 1`, so each bin holds
whole values).

Geometrically spaced bins from the smallest positive value to `max`; values ≤ 0 are
counted in `nonpositive`. Suited to data spanning decades (photon counts, spectra).

ImageStats.description: Statistics of every selected plane of one image (the selection aggregate).

components.description:
Multi-sample (RGB) pixels: the statistics of each colour component over those planes
(`components[0]` = red, `[1]` = green, `[2]` = blue).

name.description: Image (scene, series, position) name, if recorded (`info` → `images[].name`).

oneOf.description: nuclei (default): touching nuclei are split
whole cells stained throughout (larger; touching cells are split)
small bright spots (puncta, foci, single molecules), found by a Laplacian of Gaussian

background.description: Its background, at the same rows.

empty.description: True when no band was found (or the lane was placed in a gap between found lanes).

profile.description: The profile from the top down, `profile_step_px` apart (with `profiles: true`).

total_volume.description:
Background-subtracted volume of the whole lane (stored units × pixels): the total
signal, e.g. for normalising to a total-protein stain.

Lanes.description: Lanes and bands of one plane.

bin.description: Full-resolution pixels per analysed pixel (1 unless the plane was binned).

lane_contrast.description:
How far the lanes stand out from the gaps between them: 1 − gap signal / lane signal of
the column profile (0 = not at all; below 0.15 the lanes are a guess).

pitch_px.description: Distance between neighbouring lane centres, pixels.

profile_step_px.description: Distance between profile values, pixels (with `profiles: true`).

saturation_level.description: The value counted as saturated, when the pixel type has one.

size_unit.description: Unit of band sizes (from the ladder).

y_range.description: Rows the lanes span: first and last (full-resolution pixels).

MeasureOutput.description: Measurements on one plane: a line profile, statistics inside a polygon or an object count.

downsample.description: Level-0 pixels per pixel of this level (1 at level 0).

level.description: Pyramid level read; coordinates are its pixels.

pixel_size_um.description: Pixel size at this level in µm, when recorded.

diameter_um.description: Diameter of a disc of the same area, in µm.

edge.description: True when the object touches the edge of the area searched (it may be cut).

height.description: Spots: height above the local background in what was measured.

id.description: Number, in reading order (the label on a picture of the objects).

mean.description: Mean raw value in each channel of `channels`, in that order.

solidity.description: Area over the area of its convex hull (1 = convex; low values suggest merged objects).

x.description: Centroid column, in pixels of the level read.

ObjectChannel.description: One channel measured in every object.

c.description: Channel index (`c`), or the RGB component or stain index.

positive.description: Objects clearly brighter than the rest (or than the background).

area_fraction.description: Fraction of the area searched covered by objects.

area_px.description: Object areas in pixels (objects off the edge, or all when every one touches it).

channels.description: Every channel measured in the objects, in the order of each object's `mean`.

confidence.description:
`high`, or `low` when less than half of the objects' area is in compact objects of the
expected size (`fit`), when most objects are under a third of the expected area, or
when more objects were found than the area holds: the image may not suit the count, or
the threshold cut noise into pieces (see `notes`).

count.description: Objects found, including those touching the edge.

density_per_mm2.description: Objects per mm² (edge objects count half).

diameter_um.description: Diameters (of a disc of the same area) in µm.

expected_diameter_px.description:
Object diameter expected, in pixels: it sets the smoothing, the background scale, how
close two objects may be and the smallest object kept.

fit.description:
Share of the objects' area in compact objects (solidity at least 0.85) of the expected
size (a third to three times the area of its disc), 0 to 1. Not for spots.

large.description: Objects more than twice the median area: possibly several objects together.

measured.description:
What objects were found in: a channel (`c=0 DAPI`), an RGB component, `luminance` or a
stain (`hematoxylin`, `eosin`, `dab`).

objects.description: The objects in reading order (top to bottom, then left to right).

region.description: The rectangle searched, in pixels of the level read.

searched_um2.description: Area searched (the region, or the polygon) in µm².

split.description: Whether touching objects were cut apart.

threshold.description:
Threshold, in units of what was measured after background subtraction (spots: height
above the local background).

threshold_method.description:
`otsu`, `otsu-3`, `triangle`, `local`, `sparse` (a few objects on a large background:
half way from the background to the objects), `noise` (spots: five robust standard
deviations of the background) or `given`.

touching_edge.description: Objects touching the edge of the area searched.

Percentiles.description: NumPy-style percentiles of the finite samples.

PixelType.description: Sample type of one channel value. Names follow OME-XML `PixelType` values.

oneOf.description: Signed 8-bit integer.
Signed 16-bit integer.
Signed 32-bit integer.
Unsigned 8-bit integer.
Unsigned 16-bit integer (the usual microscope camera output).
Unsigned 32-bit integer.
32-bit IEEE 754 floating point.
64-bit IEEE 754 floating point.
Signed 64-bit integer.
Unsigned 64-bit integer.
Complex number of two 32-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `complex`.
Complex number of two 64-bit floats (real, then imaginary): OME `double-complex`.

components.description: Multi-sample (RGB) pixels: the statistics of each colour component on its own.

level.description: Pyramid level (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0.

oneOf.description: from the image: dark objects on a bright background (brightfield) or bright ones
objects brighter than the background (fluorescence)
objects darker than the background (brightfield)

Positive.description: Objects above a threshold in one channel.

count.description: Objects whose mean is above it.

fraction.description: The same as a fraction of all objects.

method.description:
`otsu` (the object means fall in two groups), `background` (the channel's background
plus five robust standard deviations) or `none` (no object is clearly brighter).

Profile.description: An intensity profile along a line.

length_um.description: Line length in µm, when the pixel size is recorded.

line.description: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in pixels of the level read.

samples.description: Samples taken along the line (one per pixel up to 20 000).

step_px.description:
Distance between the returned values in pixels (the first is at the start, the last
at the end).

step_um.description: Distance between the returned values in µm.

c.description: Channel index (`c`), or the RGB component for RGB images.

fwhm_px.description: Full width at half maximum of the highest peak above the line's minimum, in pixels.

max_at_px.description: Distance of the largest value from the start, in pixels.

max_at_um.description: The same in µm, when the pixel size is recorded.

values.description:
The profile, one value every `step_px` from the start (at most 200; each the mean of the
samples it covers).

Projection.description: The axis of a maximum-intensity projection (`stats --mip z`).

oneOf.description: Along z: one projected plane per image, channel and time point.
Along t: one projected plane per image, channel and z.

Region.description: A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

x.description: Left edge (column of the first pixel).

y.description: Top edge (row of the first pixel).

area_um2.description: Area in µm², when the pixel size is recorded.

polygon.description: The vertices, in pixels of the level read.

RoiChannel.description: Statistics of one channel inside a polygon.

c.description: Channel index (`c`), or the RGB component.

SampleStats.description: Summary statistics of a set of samples.

exact.description: True when the percentiles and histogram are exact (see the module documentation).

min.description: Absent when there are no finite samples (as are mean, std, percentiles).

non_finite.description: NaN and infinite samples (excluded from everything else).

saturated_count.description:
Integer pixel types: the number of samples at `saturation_level` (exact; use it for
"how many pixels are saturated").

saturated_fraction.description:
Integer pixel types: fraction of samples at the saturation level
(`saturation_level`): the detector's ceiling 2^bits − 1 when the file records its
significant bits (16383 for 14-bit data stored as uint16), else the type's maximum (255
for uint8, 65535 for uint16, …), i.e. clipped by the detector or the digitizer.

saturation_level.description: The value a sample must equal to count as saturated (integer pixel types).

saturation_source.description:
For `significant_bits`: the `info` field the bit depth came from, e.g.
`images[].extra.component_bit_count` (CZI) or `images[].extra.bits_significant`.

zero_fraction.description: Fraction of finite samples equal to 0.

bins.description:
Requested histogram bins (0 = none). Integer data with fewer distinct values in its
range uses fewer, one per value.

channels.description: One aggregate per image and channel.

format.description: Format id of the input file.

images.description: One aggregate per image over all its selected planes.

images_skipped.description:
Images left out of a run over every image because the reader refuses their pixel data
(raw FLIM photon histograms, for one; `info` notes say which). Absent when none were.

level.description: Pyramid level the planes were read at (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0.

mip.description:
Set with `--mip`: the statistics are of maximum-intensity projections along this axis
(per pixel, the largest value over the selected planes); `planes[]` entries are the
projections, with the projected axis's index reported as 0.

region.description:
The rectangle of each plane the statistics cover (level pixel coordinates), when a
region was asked for; absent = whole planes.

select.description: The selection as given (`c=0`, …); empty = every plane.

WellStatsOutput.description: Output of `stats --per well` and MCP `openreadout_stats` with `per: "well"`.

columns.description: Column names of `rows`, in order (for tables and CSV).

format.description: Format id of the input file.

level.description: Pyramid level read (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0.

notes.description: Things to know when reading the rows (absent planes left out, missing files skipped).

per_field.description: True when rows are per field of view.

plate.description: Plate id or barcode, when recorded.

rows.description:
One row per (well, channel), or per (well, field, channel) with `per_field`, in plate
order (row by row, then field, then channel).

select.description: The selection as given; empty = every plane.

wells_without_data.description: Selected wells without a single readable plane (every file missing).

WellStatsRow.description:
One tidy row of [`WellStatsOutput`]: the statistics of one channel over the selected planes
of one well (or one field of it).

field.description: Per-field rows only: the field number as the acquisition software counts it.

fields.description: Fields of view whose planes were read into this row.

image.description: Per-field rows only: the image index of the field.

mean.description: Mean intensity (absent when no plane was read).

planes_missing.description: Selected planes whose files are missing (skipped).

plate.description: Plate id or barcode, when recorded (the same on every row).

saturated_fraction.description: Integer data: fraction of samples at the type's maximum (detector saturation).
